name: Ropes: a heavy ball on a rod swings into a tower of blocks, a chain of rods hangs and swings, a ball on a spring settles where the pull balances the weight

expect.name: Wrecking ball
expect.message: the rod keeps the ball 8 m from its hook: never lower than 3 m

expect.name: Wrecking ball
expect.message: and never higher than where it was let go (a little slack for the correction)

expect.name: Block 7
expect.message: the ball knocked the top of the tower more than 5 m to the right

expect.name: Block 1
expect.message: while the bottom of the tower stayed where it was

expect.name: Chain 5
expect.message: the end of the chain swings below the hook

expect.name: Spring ball
expect.message: settled where 60 N/m balance 9.8 N: 3.16 m below the hook
